README.null: v20 adds a single-study-unit primary 24-h continuous opioid set. It prevents multi-arm double counting, separates derived/weight-normalized/POD1/proxy endpoints, and keeps the Yeh 2010/2011 publication family on overlap hold.

63 source studies/reports. The 61-PDF Sol master was supplemented with two distinct Chen 2015 trials. Antigravity's unsupported 'Gao 2018' row is excluded; Zhou 2025 is restored from its source-grounded extraction.
Source PDF / supplement / protocol / registration > reconciled source-grounded extraction > derivative AI/model output > Covidence shell/payload.
No majority vote between models. Missing/unreported data remain missing. Graph-derived/calculated values must remain explicitly labelled as derived.

RoB 2 is result-specific. Original stored RoB files are not analysis-ready. Corrected RoB judgments currently completed for 6 selected results; remaining invalid/re-adjudication cases are tracked in Study_Master.
Antigravity's forensic audit is retained as a comparison source, but its study/file mappings and payload values are not accepted automatically. Candidate source summaries remain visibly labelled.
Rows marked NOT READY or SOURCE-QC REQUIRED must not be used as final meta-analysis/RoB inputs until the stated issue is resolved.
